AvailableExecutor.description: An executor or adapter available from a repository for this host (`executor search`, `adapter search`).

adapter.description: For a VMM package: the adapter that runs it. Null for a self-contained executor.

advisory.description: The repository's advisory for this version, one line, if any.

line.description:
Main version: `version` up to its first `-` or `+` (`1.18.0` for `1.18.0+wick.2`). Without `--all`, only the newest
patch of each main version is listed.

protocol.description: Executor protocol version it speaks. Null for a VMM package (see `adapter`).

yanked.description: Whether the repository has yanked this version: it is skipped unless asked for by its exact version.

build_cache.description: How many build cache entries (cached steps) were removed.

BuildEvent.description:
One line of `build` (JSON Lines): a step's progress (`step`), a piece of `RUN` output (`output`), then the image
(`built`), then one `exported` line for each output that is not sbx's image store (one per pushed name). A failed
build ends with the error line instead.

data.description: `output`: the bytes as text (invalid UTF-8 replaced).

dest.description:
`exported`: where it went: a file or directory path, `-` (stdout), `docker` (`docker load`), or the reference
that was pushed.

id.description:
`built`: the image ID (the config's digest, also when the image was not kept). `exported`: the manifest's
digest (the same each time the same image is exported).

stage_index.description: `step`: the stage's number (0 is the first stage in the Dockerfile that the build needs).

step.description: `step`: the step's number in its stage (1 is `FROM`).

steps.description: `step`: how many steps the stage has (with `FROM`).

stored.description: `built`: whether the image was kept in sbx's image store (`--output type=sbx`, the default).

text.description: `step`: the instruction with its variables expanded.

custom_kernel.description: Whether it can boot a kernel shipped in the image.

live_share.description: Whether it can share host folders live (`-v`, bind).

rootfs_formats.description: Root filesystem formats it can attach.

ChosenExecutor.description: The executor sbx would use (`executor current`, `which`).

adapter.description: For a VMM package: the adapter (`name@version`) that runs it.

name.description: Name of the installed executor. Null for a path given with `--executor` or found on PATH.

program.description: Executable that runs (for a VMM package, its adapter).

source.description: Where it was chosen from: `--executor`, a `.sbx-executor` file path, the default, or PATH.

version.description: Version of the installed executor. Null when `name` is null.

vmm_dir.description: For a VMM package: its directory, passed to the adapter as `SBX_EXECUTOR_VMM_DIR`.

Connect.description: One `--connect`: a port of another sandbox, reached by a name inside.

name.description: The name programs inside use (`db` in `db:5432`).

port.description: The TCP port inside that sandbox.

sandbox.description:
The sandbox it reaches: a name (a sandbox recreated under that name is reached too) or a full ID. Looked up
again at each connection.

active.description:
Images some sandbox uses; sandboxes that are running; volumes a running sandbox has attached; executors and
adapters a running sandbox was started with. Always 0 for the build cache.

reclaimable.description:
Bytes `system prune -a` would free: unused images with the layers only they use, stopped sandboxes, the
layers only the build cache holds (`system prune` frees those too); for volumes, the ones no sandbox uses
(`system prune -a --volumes`).

shared.description:
For images: the part of `size` that more than one image uses (shared layers). For the build cache: layers
that images use too (counted under images, not in `size`). Always 0 for the others.

size.description:
Bytes they take on disk (a sandbox's writable disk counts what it wrote, not its size). A layer several images
share is counted once.

total.description:
How many there are (executors count installed executors and adapters; the build cache counts cached
steps).

Done.description: One sandbox that `stop`, `restart`, `kill` or `rm` acted on.

target.description: The argument as given (name, ID or ID prefix).

exit_code.description: The exit code sbx ends with. Only on the last line, when the whole command failed.

message.description: Human-readable message. Its wording may change.

target.description:
The argument (sandbox or image) this error is about, when a command takes several and this one failed.
The others still ran.

ErrorLine.description: An error, written to stderr as one line.

attributes.description:
Details. Sandbox: `image`, `name`; on `stop` also `exit_code` and `error`. Image: `reference` (`pull`,
`tag`, `untag`, `push`: the reference pushed to; `build`: the first `-t`), `rootfs_format` (`prepare`).

id.description: Sandbox ID, image ID or volume name.

adapter.description: For a VMM package: the adapter (`name@version`) that runs it.

capabilities.description: What it supports. Null if it could not be asked (see `error`).

error.description: Why it could not be asked.

name.description: `name@version` of the installed executor that a new sandbox would use, its `--executor` path, or `none`.

program.description: Executable that would run (for a VMM package, its adapter). Null if none.

source.description: Where it was chosen from: `--executor`, a `.sbx-executor` file path, the default, or PATH. Null if none.

ExecutorRef.description: An executor or adapter by name and version (`executor install`, `use`, `rm`, `adapter install`, `adapter rm`).

exit_code.description: Exit code of the main process.

build.description:
For an image `sbx build` stored: where it was built, to build it again. Absent for pulled and loaded images,
and for images built before sbx recorded it. Kept only in the local image store: it never goes into the
image's config, history or labels, nor into anything `save`, `push` or `build --output` writes.

compressed_size.description: Sum of the compressed layer sizes, in bytes.

disk_size.description:
Bytes this image takes on disk: its record, its compressed layers, its layer disks and any merged disk it
uses. Layers it shares with other images are counted in full here (like `SIZE` in `docker system df -v`).

exposed_ports.description: Ports the image declares (`ExposedPorts`, e.g. `80/tcp`), for information: sbx opens no ports.

ignored_fields.description: Image config fields sbx does not apply.

prepared.description: Root filesystem formats that are prepared (layer disks ready for some executor's disk count).

references.description: Normalized references that point to this image. Empty if none does.

shared_size.description: The part of `disk_size` that other images also use (shared layers). Counted once in `system df`.

unique_size.description: The part of `disk_size` only this image uses: what `rmi` frees.

volumes.description:
Paths the image declares as volumes (`Volumes`), for information: sbx creates no volumes, they stay on the
sandbox's writable disk.

ImageBuild.description:
Where a stored image was built (`images`): the last `sbx build` that stored this image ID. Build arguments,
`--allow` rules and other flags are not recorded.

context.description: Absolute path of the build context directory.

file.description: Absolute path of the Dockerfile; null when it was read from stdin (`-f -`).

target.description: The `--target` stage; null when none was given.

guest_init.description: Guest init in use: a path, or `embedded in sbx`.

hypervisor.description: Whether this host can run VMs.

update.description: What the last new-version check found, when there is a recent one (`sbx upgrade --check` makes one).

advisory.description: The repository's advisory for this version, one line, if any.

origin.description: The repository it was downloaded from, or `local`. Null if not recorded.

running.description:
Running sandboxes started with it (name or short ID). `executor adapter rm` refuses it while there are any,
and `executor prune` keeps it.

used_by.description: Installed VMM packages (`name@version`) that use an adapter of this name.

yanked.description: Whether its repository has yanked this version (from the last `executor search` or `install`; it still runs).

adapter.description: For a VMM package: the adapter that runs it. Null for a self-contained executor.

advisory.description: The repository's advisory for this version, one line, if any.

default.description: Whether it is the default (`executor use`).

origin.description:
The repository it was downloaded from, or `local` (installed with `--from`). Null if installed by an sbx that
did not record it.

path.description: Path of its executable; for a VMM package, its directory.

running.description:
Running sandboxes started with it (name or short ID). `executor rm` refuses it while there are any, and
`executor prune` keeps it.

yanked.description: Whether its repository has yanked this version (from the last `executor search` or `install`; it still runs).

LogLine.description:
A piece of the main process output (`logs`): one line, or the part of a line that had arrived. A line
whose `data` does not end with a newline continues in the next `LogLine` of the same stream.

data.description: The bytes, with the trailing newline if the line ended, encoded as `encoding` says.

encoding.description: `utf-8` if the bytes are valid UTF-8 (`data` is that text), otherwise `base64` (standard alphabet, padded).

time.description:
When sbx received it (RFC 3339, nanoseconds). Lines that arrived together share a time. Always set by
sbx 0.2.1 and later; kept nullable for scripts written against 0.2.0's schema.

location.description: The file's path, or the helper program's name.

stored.description: `file` (the `auths` of a Docker or containers credentials file) or `helper` (a `docker-credential-*` program).

removed.description: Whether there were credentials to remove.

Mount.description: A folder shared with the host.

oneOf.description: Copied in when the sandbox starts.

connect.description: Ports of other sandboxes it reaches by name (`--connect`), with either mode. Absent when there are none.

Prepared.description: A root filesystem that is ready (`prepare`).

built.description: Whether it was built now (`false`: it already existed).

build_cache.description:
How many build cache entries (cached steps) were removed. Their layers are in `layers` when no image uses
them.

leftovers.description: Paths of removed leftovers (unfinished pulls and builds, half-removed sandboxes).

Pruned.description: An executor or adapter version that `executor prune` removed, or would remove with `--dry-run`.

id.description: Image ID (`sha256:…` of the image config).

Pushed.description: An image pushed to a registry (`push`; one line per tag with `-a`).

blobs.description: Layers (each once), then the image config.

id.description: Image ID: the `sha256:…` of the manifest, the same as before the push (it is sent as it was pulled).

reference.description: Normalized reference it was pushed to, e.g. `ghcr.io/me/app:1`.

size.description: Size of the manifest in bytes.

PushedBlob.description: One blob of a pushed image.

mounted_from.description: For `mounted`: the repository it came from (`registry/repository`).

status.description:
`exists` (the registry had it, nothing sent), `mounted` (taken from another repository of the same
registry, nothing sent) or `uploaded`.

Removed.description: The result for one image given to `rmi`.

deleted.description: Image ID and layer digests deleted. Empty if only a reference was removed.

keys.description: minisign public keys that sign its index. Empty for an unsigned repository.

url.description: URL. The index is `<url>/v2/index.json` (or `<url>/index.json` for an old unsigned repository).

created.description: When it was created. Null if the file system does not record it.

egress_limit_bytes.description: Bytes its outgoing connections may move per start (`--egress-limit`); absent when unlimited.

error.description: Why it stopped, if an error stopped it.

exit_code.description: Exit code of the main process, once it has exited.

interactive.description: Whether the main process's stdin is open (`-i`).

ports.description:
Published ports (`-p`) as `HOST_IP:HOST_PORT->PORT/tcp`. While it runs, the addresses it listens on (with
the port the OS picked for a `-p PORT`); otherwise what was asked for (`:0` = pick one).

timeout_secs.description: Seconds after each start when sbx stops it (`--timeout`); absent when it runs until stopped.

tty.description: Whether the main process has a terminal (`-t`).

reference.description: The reference it was pulled as. Null if the image has since been removed.

SandboxRef.description: A sandbox that was created or started (`create`, `run -d`, `start`).

SandboxVolume.description: A named volume a sandbox attaches.

no_copy.description: An empty volume is not filled from the image (`nocopy`).

Stats.description: One running sandbox's resource use (`stats`), as its guest reports it.

cpu_percent.description: CPU use over the last second; 100 is one vCPU fully busy (like Docker).

disk_used.description: Bytes used on the writable disk.

memory_used.description: Memory in use, in bytes (total minus available).

timeout_secs.description: Seconds to wait before powering off. Null: the command's default.

Tagged.description: A reference added to an image (`tag`).

id.description: Image ID it now points at.

UpdateInfo.description: What the last new-version check found (`info`).

advisory.description: The release index's one-line advisory for this sbx's version.

checked_at.description: When the release index was read (Unix seconds).

latest.description: The newest release for this platform above this sbx, not yanked; null when this is the newest.

security.description: A release between this sbx and `latest` fixes a vulnerability.

yanked.description: This sbx's version has been withdrawn.

advisory.description: The release index's one-line advisory for `current`.

installed.description: The version now installed; null with --check or when there was nothing to do.

latest.description: The newest release for this platform above `current`, not yanked; null when `current` is the newest.

security.description: A release between `current` and `latest` fixes a vulnerability.

Volume.description: A named volume (`volume create`, `volume ls`, `volume inspect`).

disk.description: The disk image on the host.

disk_usage.description: Bytes the disk takes on the host. The disk is sparse, so this grows with what sandboxes write.

in_use.description: Whether a running sandbox has it attached now.

sandboxes.description: IDs of the sandboxes that attach it, running or not. `volume rm` refuses while there are any.

size.description: Disk size in bytes: the most it can hold.
